## Summary

When a repo is enrolled into the memory plugin, we should inject a small local skill into \`.agents/skills/\` that provides graceful degradation when the plugin itself is not installed. The skill should:

### (a) Detect if the plugin is installed
Check whether the repo-memory plugin is active/available in the current agent environment.

### (b) If not installed — guide the agent to use the persisted memory map
Even without the plugin, the persisted memory map (\`GEMINI.md\` or equivalent) still exists in the repo. The skill should tell the agent how to read and use that file for context, even though it can't update it automatically.

### (c) Provide instructions on how to install and enable the plugin and enroll the repo
Give the agent (and indirectly the user) clear instructions on how to:
- Install the repo-memory plugin
- Enable it in their configuration
- Enroll the current repo so memory is actively maintained

## Motivation

This creates a \"works anywhere\" experience. Even if a collaborator or CI environment doesn't have the plugin installed, the skill ensures the agent still benefits from the persisted memory and knows how to get the full plugin experience set up.
